text:
Priya Patel: FYI Calyx Health flagged an oddity on their renewal invoice — looks like HSM add-on and platform fee credit were applied twice.
Ethan Cole: Ugh, can you paste the invoice lines? I just pulled their renewal. Invoice 88421.
Priya Patel: Here are the relevant lines:
```
Invoice 88421
- Private Deployment subscription: $45,000
- Platform fee (annual): $9,000
- Platform fee credit (promo): -$3,000
- HSM add-on: $2,500
- HSM add-on (duplicate): $2,500  <-- suspect
- Support tier (Enterprise): $12,000
- Proration credit for tier change: -$6,000
Total: $61,000
```
Maya Rivera: Wait — they moved from Standard->Enterprise mid-term and we agreed to prorate support only, not platform fee. Did billing apply the platform credit twice or is that a reversed charge + credit? @BillingBot can you reconcile?
BillingBot: (automated) Received request. Scanning invoice 88421 for duplicate line items and applied credits. Preliminary result: duplicate HSM line present; platform fee credit appears twice due to merge of legacy credit memos. Creating case BLG-2026-394.
Ethan Cole: Thx. If HSM was billed twice we should issue a refund or credit. Also need to confirm whether the platform fee promo is still valid after the support tier upgrade — contract clause 4.2 says promotions expire on tier change.
Legal - Kate: I can confirm clause 4.2. However, we typically honor outstanding promo credits that were already invoiced in prior period unless explicitly revoked. Need agreement text from the renewal amendment.
Priya Patel: Attached snippet from contract: "Promotional platform fee credits granted during the term are non-transferable on tier upgrades unless expressly stated in amendment." No amendment here.
Vikram (Billing Eng): Quick update from metering side — our export shows only one HSM usage event. The second HSM line is a duplicated memo merging issue when we applied an account-level adjustment. I can remove the duplicate and regenerate a credit note.
Maya Rivera: Great. Can we also validate that the proration credit for support was calculated correctly? I see -$6,000 but timeline looks off.
Ethan Cole: I'll check the onboarding date and support change timestamp. If proration window was shorter we owe them less, so they might end up owing instead of getting a credit.
Priya Patel: Let's do this: Vikram, remove duplicated HSM line and issue a credit note for $2,500. Ethan, confirm proration calc and post here. Kate, please note legal position if customer disputes promo revocation. I'll hold any payment adjustments until both items are sorted.
BillingBot: (automated) Credit note CN-5567 created for $2,500. Case BLG-2026-394 updated.
Ethan Cole: Confirmed support change effective 2025-11-15, proration to renewal date 2026-01-01. Raw calc I ran: enterprise daily rate leads to credit of $4,800, not $6,000. So invoice over-credited by $1,200.
Priya Patel: Okay — two fixes then: (1) credit $2,500 for duplicate HSM, (2) debit back $1,200 to correct proration over-credit. Net credit to customer $1,300. Maya, please approve adjustment so we can send corrected invoice.
Maya Rivera: Approved. I'll coordinate with Customer Success to message Calyx and include CN-5567 plus corrected invoice. Draft message: "We corrected a duplicated HSM charge and adjusted a proration calculation; net credit $1,300 applied. See attached corrected invoice and credit note." Want to loop legal?
Legal - Kate: Loop me on the customer message. Suggest wording that makes clear this was an internal billing error and we corrected it proactively.
Priya Patel: Perfect. Ethan — can you follow up with a short reconciliation note showing original vs corrected totals, and post PDF attachments here when ready? I'll sign off before client notification.
Ethan Cole: On it. Will upload reconciliation + PDFs by EOD PST.
Priya Patel: Thanks all :thumbsup:
